clue.text: Bid for chest that does not open

indicators.note: a chest that does not open has lost its opening, so the first letter of the synonym goes

parts.note: a coffer is a strongbox or chest

explanation.surface: Someone makes an offer for a locked chest that will not open.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the first letter C from COFFER.
explanation.definitionFit: To bid is to make a proposal of a price, a synonym.

clue.text: Tyrant confining mob inside poor parts

indicators.note: confining means one piece holds the other enclosed within it, here around the mob
parts is read as splits up, so the letters of the word poor are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging
to mob is to crowd round, to press

explanation.surface: A despot keeps the rabble penned up in the poor districts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'parts' is the anagram signal, not a noun for districts; 'confining' is the container signal, leaving 'inside' as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A tyrant is a cruel ruler, one who crushes the people under him.

clue.text: Highest conifer over the way

indicators.note: in a down clue over means the tree is placed above the road abbreviation

parts.note: a fir is a cone-bearing tree
ST, short for street, a way

explanation.surface: The tallest pine stands above the road.
explanation.definitionFit: Highest in rank or order means foremost, top of the list.

clue.text: Violently tears butter-paper

parts.note: a butter is something that butts, such as a ram
pages are sheets of paper

explanation.surface: Someone angrily rips up the greaseproof wrapping from the butter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'butter' is not the spread but one who butts, a ram.
explanation.definitionFit: To rampage is to rush about wildly, as tears in the sense of charging around.

clue.text: Accountant with capital advanced something to put on a horse

definitions.text: something to put on a horse

parts.note: CA stands for chartered accountant
Paris is the French capital
on means forward, advanced

explanation.surface: A financier and the French capital have moved ahead with some equestrian gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A caparison is an ornamental cloth or covering draped over a horse.

clue.text: Bank's jargon

definitions.meaning: to tilt or slope, as an aircraft does in turning
the private language or slang of a group

explanation.surface: A banker's specialist vocabulary.
explanation.definitionFit: Cant is both an inclined slope and the hypocritical or specialist lingo of a set of people.

clue.text: Weapon to quicken the pulse

parts.note: pulse means beans or peas, and to quicken them is to fire them fast through a tube, not to excite the heart

explanation.surface: An armament designed to make the heart race.
explanation.definitionFit: A toy tube that blows dried legumes is a child's weapon firing pulses at speed.

clue.text: Commotion made by strange Manx cat

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or strange

indicators.note: a Manx cat famously has no tail, so the word for cat loses its last letter

parts.note: puss is a familiar word for cat

explanation.surface: An odd tailless cat from the Isle of Man causes a disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Manx' docks the final S of PUSS, as the Manx breed lacks a tail.
explanation.definitionFit: A rumpus is a noisy uproar or fracas.

clue.text: Feeling a thrill

definitions.meaning: a physical perception through the senses
a stir of excitement or a sensational event

explanation.surface: Getting a buzz from something exciting.
explanation.definitionFit: Sensation names both a bodily perception and a stir of public excitement.

clue.text: Itinerant's best friend turned up

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Damon was the devoted friend of Pythias in Greek legend

explanation.surface: A wanderer's most loyal companion has appeared.
explanation.walkthrough: Damon and Pythias are the classical byword for loyal friendship; 'turned up' reverses DAMON.
explanation.definitionFit: A wanderer with no fixed home lives a roaming life.

clue.text: Uncontrolled firing in extremely panicky Black Sea state

indicators.note: extremely asks for the extreme letters of the word panicky, its first and last

parts.note: Romania has a Black Sea coastline

explanation.surface: Wild shooting erupts in a jittery Balkan country.
explanation.walkthrough: The first and last letters of 'panicky' are P and Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Pyromania is a compulsion to start fires, arson out of control.

clue.text: Note how male follows short skirt

indicators.note: follows puts the male's letter after the skirt

parts.note: a mini is a very short skirt

explanation.surface: Observe how a man trails after a girl in a miniskirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A minim is a musical value, a half note.

clue.text: Reversal for fellow-batsman, without a run, giving catch

indicators.note: without signals the run is taken out of what remains
Reversal for tells us the word for fellow-batsman is written back to front

parts.note: in cricket your partner is the other batsman at the crease
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A cricketer runs out his partner, who is then caught.
explanation.walkthrough: PARTNER backwards is RENTRAP; 'without' removes the R for run.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrap is to ensnare or trick someone into capture.

clue.text: Twist and Shout? Grand!

indicators.note: twist means the letters are wrung into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: The Beatles song Twist and Shout gets an enthusiastic review.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Twist and Shout' is a famous rock song title, so 'Twist' hides as part of a name.
explanation.definitionFit: A grand is slang for a thousand pounds or dollars.

clue.text: Deploy mop as crude means of keeping house dry

indicators.note: deploy means arrange differently, so these letters are set out in a new order

parts.note: taken as written for rearranging

explanation.surface: Using a mop is a rough way of drying out the house.
explanation.definitionFit: A damp-proof layer in a wall stops moisture rising into a building.

clue.text: Occupation of Jude? No, Amos — sent all over the place

indicators.note: all over the place means scattered, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Asking about a biblical figure's job and being told it was another prophet, sent everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: Jude is Hardy's Jude the Obscure, who worked cutting stone; the surface pretends it is the biblical Jude alongside Amos.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardy's hero Jude Fawley earned his living as a stone-cutter and builder.

clue.text: Butterfly found in old, rank, dump

parts.note: a range is a row or rank
a tip is a rubbish dump

explanation.surface: An insect turns up in a smelly old rubbish heap.
explanation.definitionFit: The orange-tip is a white butterfly whose males have orange wingtips.

clue.text: Royal family at opening of games

parts.note: kin are one's relatives

indicators.note: at opening of picks the first letter of the word games

explanation.surface: The royals appear at the start of the Games.
explanation.definitionFit: A king is a royal person, a monarch.

clue.text: Naive to speed in open area surrounding town

parts.note: green means inexperienced or naive
to belt is to go at speed

explanation.surface: A novice drives too fast in the countryside around town.
explanation.definitionFit: A protected ring of countryside around a city where building is restricted.

clue.text: Discontinue diet

parts.note: a diet here is a legislative assembly, not a regime of eating, and its sitting is suspended

explanation.surface: Someone gives up their eating plan.
explanation.definitionFit: To prorogue is to suspend a parliament's session without dissolving it.

clue.text: Engine noise made by right propeller

parts.note: an oar propels a boat

explanation.surface: The sound of a motor comes from the starboard propeller.
explanation.definitionFit: A roar is a loud deep sound, as from a revving motor.

clue.text: Turning up face

explanation.surface: Someone shows their face by arriving.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun covers both an arrival and someone's outward look.

clue.text: Oarsman's achievement

definitions.meaning: the rower nearest the stern who sets the pace
a feat, as in a masterly move

explanation.surface: A rowing triumph.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names the pace-setting rower and also a successful feat, as of genius.

clue.text: Big crowd outside at diplomatic residence

indicators.note: outside means the crowd wraps around the word at

parts.note: a legion is a vast multitude

explanation.surface: A mass of protestors gathers outside the embassy.
explanation.definitionFit: A legation is a diplomatic mission or its building, below an embassy.

clue.text: Grub available in spectacular variety

indicators.note: available in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Food served in a dazzling assortment.
explanation.definitionFit: A grub is an insect in its early wormlike stage.

clue.text: Sea creature's nipper

definitions.meaning: a spiny echinoderm of the seabed
a small child, especially a scruffy one

explanation.surface: A marine animal with a bite.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a spiny marine animal and a mischievous youngster.

clue.text: An audience for Leo, for example

definitions.meaning: one of the twelve divisions of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A lion is granted a meeting with someone.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a theatre's spectators and an astrological sign's division.

clue.text: Have charge of marbles?

definitions.meaning: slang for one's wits or sanity

explanation.surface: Being in charge of a child's game of marbles.
explanation.definitionFit: To look after something, and also one's intellect, as in losing one's marbles.

clue.text: Allowance cut for relation

indicators.note: cut means the word is docked of its final letter

parts.note: a ration is a fixed allowance

explanation.surface: A family member's allowance has been reduced.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio is a proportional relationship between quantities.

clue.text: Reading between the lines?

parts.note: not inferring a hidden meaning but measuring the gap between two rails of track

explanation.surface: Inferring what is not openly said.
explanation.definitionFit: The track width is the measured distance between a railway's two rails.

clue.text: Fear paper coming out before hospital closure

indicators.note: coming out means the letters are released into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
an end is a closure

explanation.surface: Dreading the newspaper report before the hospital is shut down.
explanation.definitionFit: To apprehend can mean to anticipate with dread.

clue.text: Flat time in race, perhaps

parts.note: even means level or flat

explanation.surface: A flat race is run against the clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A race is one example of a sporting contest or fixture.
